newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 25.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 25.30 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate fell by 47.50 basis points to 25.30 percent on Wednesday, from 25.7750 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 58.84 basis points to 25.2563 percent on Wednesday from 25.8447 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 62.50 basis points to 25.5250 percent, from 26.15 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
